_what: Tasks an AI (or a rule) found in something, kept as proposals the person reviews before they become real Calendar tasks (src/task-proposals.mjs). A proposal is a row of the generic Lists owner (`list`), so it is searchable, shared and exported like any list. `states` are the review states: a new proposal is `proposed`; approving it makes the Calendar task and records it; rejecting it keeps the row so the same finding is not proposed again; restoring un-rejects it; undoing an approval deletes the task it made and returns the proposal to proposed. `id_chars` caps the source id and the title that identify a finding. `words` are every sentence read by the person or their AI.

words.proposed: Proposed: {title}. Approve it to make the task, or reject it.
words.already_rejected: {title} was rejected earlier, so it was not proposed again. Restore it to review it again.
words.rejected: Rejected: {title}. It will not be proposed again.
words.restored: Restored: {title} is waiting for review again.
words.undone: Taken back: the task for {title} is deleted and the proposal is waiting for review again.
words.approved_cannot_reject: {title} is already a task. Undo the approval first.
words.not_approved: {title} was not approved, so there is no task to take back.
words.not_editable: {title} is {state}; only a proposal waiting for review can be changed.
words.bad_items: Give items: a list of up to {most} tasks, each with a title.
words.bad_title: A task needs a title of {most} characters or fewer.
words.bad_action: Choose propose, approve, reject, restore, undo_approval, edit or read.
